card.name: Disclaimer wording in notices and trial text
card.fires_on: The word that continues a stock disclaimer or permissions notice, such as 'not' after 'may', 'necessarily' after 'do not', or 'for' in 'may be edited for content'. It appears in web-page footers and in drug-label trial-rate caveats.

modes.label: Web disclaimers and permissions
modes.description: Words inside views-expressed, reuse, or editing notices on news and press pages.
modes.example: The views expressed here do not<< necessarily>> represent those of KOKI FOX2

modes.label: Trial-rate caveat
modes.description: Words in the standard statement that adverse reaction rates differ between trials and practice.
modes.example: of a drug cannot be directly compared to rates in the clinical trials of another drug and may<< not>> reflect the rates observed in practice.

card.writes: It suppresses disclaimer and copyright-style tokens (mostly Chinese), so it seems to dampen continuing such a notice.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of stock disclaimer sentences, like 'may not reflect' or 'materials may be edited for content'.
